title: Schema for the command cards data file

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

cost.description: The cost associated with using this command card.

limit.description: Determines the maximum number of copies of this command card in your command deck.

back_id.description: Foreign key to this card's back in data/card-backs.json.

image.description: The file path for this command card's image.
